_note: Viral Lab (Host): permanently integrate an extracted virus into a host class. The strain item is consumed. Each integrated strain adds Viral Load; above the class's stable load the host gains a random instability side effect each raid. Integrated strains apply at a fraction of their raid-injection strength but never wear off, and change the host's resting look.

instability.label: Tremor
instability.look: hands visibly tremble in first person

instability.label: Fever Glow
instability.look: skin glows faintly at all times

instability.label: Tumour Growth
instability.look: a pulsing growth bulges on one shoulder

instability.label: Neural Static
instability.look: scanner and HUD flicker with static

purge.description: removes one integrated strain; the strain is lost
